critique_history.assessment:
- Numerous ridge curves float above the shell, especially around the spire; replace them with fewer ridges tightly conforming to the surface.
- The axial and transverse curves form an unnatural basket-like cage rather than shell growth ridges.
- Several spire seams and the topmost pieces are visibly disconnected; overlap and integrate all whorls into a continuous pointed spire.
- The aperture resembles an attached oval plate; recess it into a genuine body opening with a thick contiguous lip.
The shell clearly has a rounded body whorl, pointed spire, strong wavy ridges, wide aperture, and convincing brown-and-cream patterning.
